newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESEARCH ALERT - Thyssen, Krupp "buy" reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thyssen, Krupp "buy" reiterated.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Salomon Brothers in London said on Friday it had reaffirmed its buy recommendation on shares in Thyssen and Krupp-Hoesch.
Steel sector analyst Terence Sinclair said the two shares had the potential to register strong gains, as merger mania boosted the stocks.
Both companies are in discussions, due to last eight days, aimed at securing a merger in their steel divisions, following a bid by Krupp earlier in the week to take over the larger Thyssen.
Krupp had offered 435 marks per share to Thyssen shareholders, a 25 percent premium over the closing share price on Monday.
Thyssen shares were up 14.20 marks, 3.78 percent, at 390 marks in bourse trade, while Krupp shares were unchanged at 313 marks.
